senses.gloss:
Dṛbhīka is the name of a man^1 or a demon,^2 who, according
to the Rigveda,^3 was slain by Indra.
1) Ludwig, Translation of the Rig-
veda, 3, 152, 207, who compares the
Derbikes; Macdonell, Vedic Mythology,
p. 162.
2) Grassmann, Wörterbuch, s.v.; Roth,
St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.;
Geldner, Rigveda, Glossar, 85.
3) ii. 14, 3.
